messages.text:
The README edit adds a `--json` usage line in the existing indented block and a short paragraph after it. The existing line 5 is unchanged.

One trade-off: `taskly list --json` is 18 characters, so its description can't start at the same column as line 5's description (column 15) without changing line 5. I kept line 5 byte-identical, as the spec asks, and used a two-space gap, so the descriptions don't line up exactly.

```diff
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -3,3 +3,7 @@
 A tiny task list CLI.
 
     taskly list    print every task, one per line
+    taskly list --json  print every task as a JSON array of {id, title, done}
+
+The default output of `taskly list` is unchanged. `--json` writes only the array to stdout, so it can be piped.
```
